comment: The REMOVED table (code critique 2). Every name the current repository imports from a frozen module is either still exported by the contract tree or listed here with its replacement. `checks/frozen-imports.cjs <repo> <tree>` fails on a name that is neither. Keys are `module:name`. Annex G of the contract prints this table.
catalog:assignSlugs: chooseSetToks() + slugBase() + withProductSuffix() + oracleSlugOf() + sealedSlugOf(); the importer inserts rows in ascending productId (4.1)
catalog:pickPrice: finishPrices() (catalog.ts): one price row per finish; OP's 'highest market wins' is DELETED (89.8% of dual-finish printings would headline the Foil row)
catalog:setKind: classifyGroup() in constants.ts (decided on the group NAME, never the abbreviation)
catalog:CatalogCard: ParsedName (catalog.ts) for the parse, MatchRow (match.ts) for the matcher, CardLite (section 12 types) for a tile
catalog:sealedKind: sealedKind() in constants.ts (the rules moved with the SEALED_KINDS list)
import:importStores: stage S8 of the importer: store-import.ts importStores(ctx, opts): Promise<StoreResult[]> (WP04); StoreResult lives in stores.ts
search:searchCards: getCardPage({ q }) / the search planner (section 7, WP07)
search:editDistance: WP07 keeps it inside the did-you-mean helper
data:getSealedCatalog: getSealedPage() / getSealedByIds() / getSealedBySet() (WP09); the 3,712 products are two list chunks of the instance memory, never one cache entry
data:getProductHistory: getUnitHistory(unit, days) (WP02 history readers): a call without a finish cannot exist
data:getCardText: oracle facts come from getOracleBySlug / getCardDetail (Scryfall-derived, free)
data:getChaseStrip: getChaseBanner() (WP05; eBay data stays in Neon, never GitHub)
match:buildDonIndex: REMOVED: Magic has no DON!! cards
match:matchDonTitle: REMOVED: Magic has no DON!! cards
match:PrintingRef: MatchRow (match.ts): one row per catalogue product, built in memory by the importer
data:getDealInputs: getDealList(country, query, who) (WP13): the ranked list is computed per request from ix/k, ix/p, ix/s, ix/f behind the Entitlement; nothing ranked is published (contract 12.3). The inputs are no longer a loader result
data:getStoreMins: getDealList(...) with a buyKeys query (Plus and Premium only) (WP13)
data:getDealRankById: getDealList(...) rows carry their rank; a page that needs one unit's rank asks getDealList with onlyUids (full access only)
data:PRICES_TAG: NEON_TAGS / DECKS_TAG / RISING_SNAPSHOTS_TAG / EBAY_BANNER_TAG / RANK_TAG (core.ts): only Neon-backed caches and the three rankings carry tags; plane data is pinned by sha and needs no purge. POST /api/revalidate purges NEON_TAGS
history:bucketOf: histBucket(id) (floor(id / 64)) and tailBucket(id) (floor(id / 512)) in data/plane/shards.ts: the bucket width changed from 2,048 to 64 (a cold card chart reads one 12 KB file, not 49 KB)
